name: A Record of Participation
summary: A certificate identity that gives an occasion dignity while stating exactly what the document records.

typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source used style CertificateRecipient.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source used style CertificateNote.

recognitionRules: Use a formal Baskerville title with plain Arial participant and activity details.
Keep the recipient name as the visual center.
Separate participation wording from any assessed achievement.
Give date, issuer and qualification enough room to be read.

principles: Use short action sentences; follow an invitation with a concrete material, choice or check.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: A moment of participation, clearly recorded.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid promises that every participant will master the skill.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Try one version, then compare it with the criterion.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use A RECORD OF PARTICIPATION as a restrained serif wordmark with paired fine rules. No seal, medal or ribbon that implies accreditation.
invariants: Use a formal Baskerville title with plain Arial participant and activity details.
Keep the recipient name as the visual center.
Separate participation wording from any assessed achievement.
adaptations: A digital certificate keeps all verification details as real text.
Change the occasion without changing the claim level.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Baskerville is a separately licensed/system font; not bundled.
Arial is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
